bibl.title: An Embalmer's Bowl with Demotic Inscription (Oriental Institute Museum E9115).
bibl.seg: Foy Scalf, An Embalmer's Bowl with Demotic Inscription (Oriental Institute Museum E9115).

Robert K. Ritner (ed.), Essays for the Library of Seshat. Studies Presented to Janet H. Johnson on the Occasion of Her 70th Birthday = Studies in Ancient Oriental Civilization. 70 (Chicago, 2017) pp. 311-323, figg.
bibl.note: Chic. Or. Inst. Inv. E9115. Medium-sized ceramic bowl with a Demotic inscription, found during EEF excavations at Atfih in 1910-1911, in connection with a grave. The bowl would have been used in the embalming of its occupant.
